newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Samancor sees 2nd half result similar to H1.
newsitem.headline: Samancor sees 2nd half result similar to H1.

text.p: Ferro-alloy producer Samancor Ltd cautioned on Monday there would be little if any improvement in second half earnings after a dismal first half performance.

The company said an increase in volumes and higher prices would help the chrome and manganese divisions show some improvement in the second half. But higher interest costs and the termination of the capitalisation of interest and costs at its Columbus Stainless joint venture would negate these gains.
"Consequently, second half results are expected to be similar to the first half," Samancor said in statement.
Columbus is a joint venture between Samancor, the state's Industrial Development Corporation and Highveld Steel and Vanadium Ltd.
Weak international markets saw attributable income plunge to 171.43 million rand in the six months to end-December from 381.92 million in the year-ago period.
